description: ancient Greek Homeric war galley seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile like a technical elevation drawing. Long low dark wooden hull with a high curved upswept stern post, a sharp pointed prow at the waterline, one row of round oar ports along the planking, and a painted eye near the bow. The whole silhouette is drawn small enough that the tip of the bow and the tip of the stern are both complete and fully visible within the picture. Isolated game asset cut out on a fully transparent background, only the ship hull.
